CVE-2019-3820.title: It was discovered that the gnome-shell lock screen since version  ...
CVE-2019-3820.description: It was discovered that the gnome-shell lock screen since version 3.15.91 did not properly restrict all contextual actions. An attacker with physical access to a locked workstation could invoke certain keyboard shortcuts, and potentially other actions.
